watch_list.short_title: Formal-verify state machines, then chart the flows
watch_list.summary: After finding implicit state machines in an app, run /create-formal-verification-skill one skill per subsystem and /statechart on your most important user flows; both skills are in pstack.

watch_list.short_title: Music explainer video from a clumsy brief
watch_list.summary: Ask Grok Bot to make a video about how a track was made, say you lack the vocabulary, then use /sharpen and /in-your-own-words so it storyboards an animatic before producing the full video.

trendy.short_title: 15 free GitHub upgrades for Grok Bot
trendy.summary: A curated list of 15 working repos covering templates, extra memory, coding harnesses, phone calls, Tesla controls, and iMessage, with a reminder to read each README before granting access.

trendy.short_title: Grok Bot found a gym and booked the free trial
trendy.summary: Have Grok Bot find a nearby gym with a free day pass and complete the trial signup; three people each ran their own bot and all three registrations went through.

trendy.short_title: Grok Build v1.0.79: rewind, Vim, and background jobs
trendy.summary: Try /rewind on long sessions without a full reload, turn on /vim-mode all to edit inside the prompt, and check the new end-of-turn count of running background commands.

trendy.short_title: Claude Proxy: hand coding tasks to Claude from Grok Bot
trendy.summary: Install this shared bot so Grok Bot can send specific coding or long-form work to Claude Code while you keep everything else in Grok Bot.

trendy.short_title: Finish one workflow A to Z, then automate it
trendy.summary: Start with a single end-to-end job, like routing App Store feedback from your bot’s email into a fix, pull request, test, merge, and ship, then automate the repeatable parts.

items.title: Would You Cast This AI Actor?
items.summary: Casting an AI actor like a real casting director: Claude writes the character prompt, Soul Cinema on Higgsfield generates four options at once, and the creator picks the one who looks like a real person, not a model.

items.title: How to Stop AI From Turning Your Text Into All Caps
items.summary: AI models slip on on-screen text, so the NERD note was created as its own image asset and every jersey take was checked against an outfit sheet until the back read exactly Nerdy23.

items.title: 小時候父母不願意聆聽自己，長大後變得會「過度補償」？｜Kelly Tsai
items.summary: A short asking whether growing up with parents who wouldn’t really listen can lead people to overcompensate as adults.
